The quote PDF names a different property and the contractor's breakdown does not reconcile. I asked the contractor to correct it, clarified to the landlord, updated the tenant, and put the job on hold with review on 26 Sept.

args.body: Hi Orin, sorry for the confusion. I mean the single Hearthline Plumbing & Bath quote (ref NBL-001-Q1, 18 Sept) for the shower/bathroom work at 4 Thistlewick Rise: remove the screen, taps and valve, fit wall and riser cladding with chrome trims, fit new bath taps and shower valve, and refit the screen. It was sent as £2,844.00 including VAT. Please don't approve it yet: the PDF shows a different property address, and the contractor's breakdown (materials £1,270, labour £1,170, VAT, a 10% commission and a 50% deposit) doesn't add up to that total. I've asked Hearthline to correct and itemise it and to confirm the leaking pipe itself is covered. I'll send you the corrected quote for your decision by 26 Sept. The tenant reports the leak is ongoing, so we'd like to move quickly once it's clear.
